Tells the limit that [SetGraphicsRefreshRate](SetGraphicsRefreshRate) set. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Print GetGraphicsRefreshRate()
```
@returns The most frames per second that Flip allows, or 0 for no limit.
